propositions: CodeReviewBatchRunner currently iterates only static req.criteria and stamps findings with reviewer_id but no logical criterion_id, leaving activated project criteria outside Round A/B execution.
Project criteria must execute exactly once in Round A only and never in Round B, with findings tagged with logical criterion_id (project.<name>) while preserving existing tags.

Project-criteria entries must be assembled at gate_dispatch.py by filtering registry.effective_criteria and registry.effective_routing for active LLM-tier project ids, then passed to the runner as an additive project_criteria tuple.
The runner must combine req.criteria with project_criteria only when req.step_id equals 'round_a'; Round B requests use only req.criteria to prevent double execution.

Missing or malformed project criterion prompts must raise a located LLMError naming the logical criterion and expected .rebar/prompts path; invalid criteria_routing.json errors propagate without silent degradation.
